Container.Name: mc-router-ui
Container.Overview: Minecraft reverse-proxy web UI (built on itzg/mc-router) with Cloudflare DDNS, Crafty Controller integration, and Docker label discovery. mc-router and the web UI run together in a single container managed by supervisord. Both services run as the unprivileged user app (UID 1000): the container starts as root only to take ownership of its data directory and then drops privileges. Grant access to the Docker socket with the socket group id.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Stores the SQLite database and persistent configuration. Ownership is repaired automatically on start. Only needs to be writable by UID 1000 if you run the container as a different user.

Config.Name: Crafty Servers Directory (optional)
Config.Description: Mount Crafty's servers directory to allow port changes through server.properties.

Config.Name: Docker Socket (optional)
Config.Description: Mount the Docker socket to discover routes from container labels. Read-only.

Config.Name: Minecraft Port
Config.Description: Minecraft ingress port.

Config.Name: mc-router API URL
Config.Description: REST API of the mc-router instance to manage. Defaults to the router running alongside the web UI.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Internal mc-router REST API port. Not exposed.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Admin account username. Created on first start only.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Admin account password, required on first start and at least 12 characters. Only used to bootstrap the account.

Config.Name: Secret Key (optional)
Config.Description: Session signing key. Leave blank to generate one and persist it to the database.

Config.Name: Session HTTPS Only
Config.Description: Set to "true" when serving the UI over TLS through a reverse proxy. Also enables HSTS.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Token (optional)
Config.Description: Cloudflare API token with DNS:Edit permission, used for DNS records and DDNS.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Zone ID (optional)
Config.Description: Cloudflare zone id. Alternative to the zone name below.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Zone Name (optional)
Config.Description: Cloudflare zone or domain name, for example example.com.

Config.Name: DDNS Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between public IP checks and DNS updates.

Config.Name: Crafty URL (optional)
Config.Description: Crafty Controller base URL, for example https://192.168.1.50:8443. Must be http or https with no embedded credentials.

Config.Name: Crafty API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Crafty Controller bearer API token.

Config.Name: Crafty Insecure Skip Verify (optional)
Config.Description: Set to "true" to skip TLS verification for a self-signed certificate. Only on a trusted network.

Config.Name: Crafty Container Host (optional)
Config.Description: Hostname or IP used for TCP health checks against Crafty servers, for example crafty or 192.168.1.50.

Config.Name: Crafty Servers Dir (optional)
Config.Description: Path inside the container to Crafty's servers directory.

Config.Name: Server Properties Path (optional)
Config.Description: Exact path to server.properties, overriding automatic detection.

Config.Name: Health Check Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between background health checks.

Config.Name: Health History Retention (hours)
Config.Description: How long health history is retained before pruning.

Config.Name: Docker Socket Path
Config.Description: Path to the Docker socket used for route discovery.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: One of CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO or DEBUG.

Config.Name: Minimum Password Length
Config.Description: Minimum length enforced for user passwords.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port used to reach the web UI. Put it behind a reverse proxy for TLS.

Config.Name: Minecraft Game Port
Config.Description: Minecraft port; must match the port forwarding on your router.
